Description:
Northern Catskill Mountain beautiful mountain environment. 300 acres of grounds, Family owned and family friendly owners and staff. Relaxed casual atmosphere, 4 star dining, 5 star golf. Main inn is a renovated 1800s charming drovers tavern with a traditional B&B feel. Other guest rooms are in buildings built from 1965 to 1985, All rooms have been renovated within the last ten years. We produce our own Maple Syrup here on our property served with breakfast. Our formal dining room seats up to 100, Our Tavern dining room seats up to 180 for banquets , weddings or outings. The golf course hosts many fund raisers and events throughout the summer months. Our Monday night scramble league is a wonderful way to meet new people while golfing. The league starts every Monday at 4:PM. Our grounds are alive with a diversity of wildlife. From the Batavia Kill stream in the valley to the top of the mountain there are many great places to explore, relax and enjoy the Catskills. At Christmans Windham House you will find on-site dining options, a tennis court, a hiking trail and a fitness centre. Other facilities offered at the property include a childrens playground. An array of activities can be enjoyed on site or in the surroundings.

Guests are provided with a full, hot breakfast during the summer and a continental breakfast during the winter. Guests have the option to purchase a hot breakfast during the winter.

It is 1 km to the nearest nightclubs.

This air-conditioned city hotel comprises 495 rooms of which 198 are suites spread over 21 floors. Facilities include a lobby with a 24-hour reception desk, a safe, a currency exchange desk, a cloakroom and a lift in addition to a newspaper stand, a hairdressing salon, a café, the Drake Bar, the Quantum 56 restaurant, the famous Parisian gourmet store Fauchon, conference facilities and public Internet access. It is possible to take advantage of the room and laundry services and cars may be parked in the hotel car park or garage (fees apply).

The spacious, elegantly appointed rooms come with an en suite bathroom with a hairdryer, a direct dial telephone, satellite/ cable TV, a double or king-sized bed, a minibar, an Internet connection and ironing equipment. Individually regulated air conditioning and heating feature as standard.

The hotel offers various massage treatments. Sports enthusiasts may work out in the state-of-the-art fitness and spa centre.

Breakfast is served each morning; lunch and dinner may be selected from a set menu.
